image_manifest.description: An asset manifest for a stylized 3D rendered scene depicting the climax of an aquatic race where three marine reptiles approach a floating finish line ribbon at high speed, with a clear winner established.

assets.name: Header Text
assets.description: Blue and yellow, stylized, irregular 3D block text reading 'RACING MARINE REPTILES!' located at the top of the image.

assets.name: Victory Text
assets.description: Bold, celebratory 3D block text reading 'PLAYER WINS!' located at the bottom of the image, styled to match the header.

assets.name: Winning Marine Reptile (Mosasaurus)
assets.description: The large Mosasaurus surging forward in a high-speed swimming pose, tail powerfully flexing, its snout breaking through a red checkered finish ribbon pulled across the surface of the water.

assets.name: Trailing Racer 1 (Elasmosaurus)
assets.description: The long-necked Elasmosaurus paddling vigorously in mid-swim just behind the leader, its head and neck extended far forward with an intensely focused, competitive expression.

assets.name: Trailing Racer 2 (Ichthyosaurus)
assets.description: The sleek Ichthyosaurus breaching slightly out of a wake on the opposite side of the leader, trailing closely behind and putting maximum effort into a final sprint.

assets.name: Floating Finish Line Ribbon
assets.description: A vibrant red checkered finish line ribbon stretched horizontally across the water's surface, anchored tightly between two large, floating neon orange buoys that are actively bobbing in the waves.

assets.name: Epicontinental Seaway Marine Environment
assets.description: Set in the sunlit turquoise-to-cobalt waters of the EPICONTINENTAL_SEAWAY formation, showing churning sea foam, aggressive water displacement wakes behind the racing animals, and clear overhead sunlight glinting off the water ripples.

assets.name: Atmospheric Perspective
assets.description: Dynamic white sea spray and trailing underwater bubble streams behind the marine reptiles to heavily emphasize forward speed, with a slight hazy, cinematic heat glow along the ocean horizon.

assets.name: Bottom Right Watermark
assets.description: A small, translucent lens-flare type logo/watermark located in the bottom-right corner.
